exposure: Postterm delivery in the first pregnancy
Recurrent and de novo postterm delivery
outcome: Composite perinatal outcome (perinatal mortality, Apgar score <7, birth injury)
Composite adverse maternal outcome (maternal death, abruptio placentae, PPH>1000ml, blood transfusions)
cohort: 233,327 primiparous women who delivered between 37+0 and 42+6 weeks with a subsequent singleton pregnancy
finding: Women with a postterm delivery in their first pregnancy have a higher risk of recurrent postterm delivery, but there is no difference in the composite adverse perinatal outcome between recurrent and de novo postterm delivery.
